lines.text: Many learners say: I very like coffee.
Better: I like coffee very much.
Say very much at the end.
Like! I like music very much.

data.why: Say very much at the end.

native.tip: “Saya sangat suka” tidak bisa diterjemahkan kata per kata. Pakai like ... very much.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I very like coffee.” 😅 Letakkan very much di akhir: “I like coffee very much.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “like”. Coba bilang “I like ... very much” untuk makananmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: “Saya sangat suka” cannot be translated word for word. Use like ... very much.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I very like coffee.” 😅 Put very much at the end: “I like coffee very much.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
